title: Ensemblr user config
description: Schema for ~/.config/ensemblr/config.json, the user-scope source of truth for Ensemblr's App settings and declarative configuration. Ensemblr watches this file: an external edit applies immediately. Every field validates independently and falls back to its own default, so one bad value costs that value rather than the file.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. Accepted and ignored by Ensemblr; editors use it for completion and validation.

schemaVersion.description: Config schema version. Ensemblr supports 1; any other value is an error diagnostic and the whole file falls back to defaults.

environment.description: User-scope environment variables passed to agent sessions, run scripts, and terminals. Names must be valid POSIX identifiers and values must be strings. A secret-looking name (TOKEN, KEY, SECRET, PASSWORD, and similar) is rejected with a diagnostic — secret values belong in the macOS Keychain via Settings, never in this file.

repositoryDefaults.description: Repository-scope defaults applied to every repository as the `user-default` source. A repository's committed .ensemblr/settings.toml and your personal per-repository rows both outrank these.

repositoryRules.description: Repository-scope defaults applied only to repositories whose path matches the rule. Rules apply in array order — a later matching rule overrides an earlier one — and every matching rule outranks `repositoryDefaults`.

security.description: User-scope security defaults, resolved under the `security.` key prefix.

ui.description: User-scope UI defaults, resolved under the `ui.` key prefix. Kept for declarative deployments; the settings window writes `app.appearance` instead.

appSettings.description: The App settings the settings window reads and writes, one object per pane.

sendShortcut.description: Key that sends a composer message. `enter` sends on Return; `mod+enter` sends on ⌘↵ and leaves Return for newlines.

followUpBehavior.description: What a message typed while an agent is still working does. `steer` interrupts with the new instruction, `queue` sends it after the turn, `block` refuses it until the turn ends.

language.description: App language. `system` follows the macOS language when it is one Ensemblr ships.

desktopNotifications.description: Post a desktop notification when an agent finishes a turn in a background tab.

notificationSound.description: Play a sound with the notification.

autoConvertLongText.description: Convert a long pasted block into an attachment chip instead of inlining it in the composer.

alwaysShowContextUsage.description: Keep the context-usage meter visible rather than showing it only as the window fills.

caffeinateWhileRunning.description: Hold a power assertion while an agent or script is running so the Mac does not sleep mid-turn.

toolCallCollapse.description: Whether a tool call in the timeline starts collapsed or expanded.

defaultModel.description: Model id new chats open with. `null` uses the runtime's own default.

defaultThinkingLevel.description: Reasoning-effort id new chats open with. `null` uses the runtime's own default.

reviewModel.description: Model id the Review action runs on. `null` falls back to `defaultModel`.

reviewThinkingLevel.description: Reasoning-effort id the Review action runs on. `null` falls back to `defaultThinkingLevel`.

hiddenModels.description: Model ids hidden from the model picker. Hiding a model does not stop a session already pinned to it.

claudeSubagentMode.description: Which delegation mechanism a first-class Claude Code chat holds. `ensemblr` spawns visible chat tabs through the control tools and denies Claude's own sub-agent tool; `native` does the reverse. Pi has no native sub-agent mechanism and ignores this.

git.description: Settings → Git. User-scope defaults; a repository's own `[git]` block outranks them.

branchPrefixSource.description: Where the prefix on a new workspace branch comes from. `github-username` resolves it through the gh CLI at workspace creation.

renameWorkspaceOnBranch.description: Rename the workspace when its branch is renamed.

deleteLocalBranchOnArchive.description: Delete the local branch when a workspace is archived. The remote branch is untouched.

archiveAfterMerge.description: Archive a workspace automatically once its pull request merges.

setUpstreamOnPush.description: Configure new workspaces so a plain `git push` sets the branch upstream.

accessibleColors.description: Color-vision-deficiency palette applied to status and diff colors.

codeTheme.description: Syntax theme for code blocks and diffs. The value names a theme *family*: Ensemblr swaps in the light or dark cut to match the app theme, so the light-cut ids are equivalent to their dark siblings.

monoFont.description: Monospace family for code blocks and diffs. Any font installed on the machine.

codeLigatures.description: Enable programming ligatures where the mono font provides them.

markdownStyle.description: Density of rendered markdown in the timeline.

terminalScrollbackMb.description: Scrollback held per terminal, in megabytes.

dictation.description: Voice dictation for the composer. Non-secret configuration only — the API key lives in the macOS Keychain, never here.

enabled.description: Show the composer's mic control and accept dictation.

baseUrl.description: Root of any OpenAI-compatible API, so OpenAI, Groq, or a local whisper-server all work without a code change.

model.description: Transcription model id sent to that endpoint.

language.description: Dictation language. Ships English-only; the field exists so widening later is a value change rather than a schema migration.

autoRunAfterSetup.description: Start the default run script automatically once a workspace's setup script exits 0.

completedAt.description: ISO timestamp at which the user left the onboarding wizard, by finishing or skipping it. `null` means it has never been shown — clearing this field by hand re-runs onboarding on the next launch.

environmentVariables.description: Environment variables as a name/value map.

managed.description: Policy-set values a user cannot override. A key listed under `locked` resolves from `managed.values` (or, failing that, from the matching `app` value) and its control is disabled in the settings window.

locked.description: Boolean tree naming the locked keys, mirroring the shape of `app`. `{ "general": { "language": true } }` locks `general.language`.

values.description: Values supplied for locked keys, mirroring the shape of `app`.

permissionMode.description: How much an agent may do without asking. `workspace-trusted` lets it act inside the workspace, `approval-required` prompts per action, `read-only` refuses every write. An unrecognised value is reported and the default stands.

repositoryRule.description: One conditional block of repository defaults.

match.description: Which repositories the rule applies to. Omitted or empty applies it to all of them.

path.description: Path fragment matched against the repository path on segment boundaries, case-insensitively: `api` matches /repos/api but not /repos/legacy-api. A non-empty `match` without a usable `path` matches nothing and reports a diagnostic.

settings.description: Repository settings applied when the rule matches.

repositorySettings.description: Repository-scope settings. The same key vocabulary Ensemblr resolves from a repository's committed .ensemblr/settings.toml, spelled in camelCase here rather than the file's snake_case.

archiveAfterMerge.description: Archive a workspace automatically once its pull request merges.

autoRunAfterSetup.description: Start the default run script automatically once the setup script exits 0.

branchFrom.description: Branch new workspaces fork from. `null` uses the repository's default branch.

branchPrefix.description: Prefix for new workspace branch names.

deleteLocalBranchOnArchive.description: Delete the local branch when a workspace is archived. The remote branch is untouched.

setUpstreamOnPush.description: Configure new workspaces so a plain `git push` sets the branch upstream.

runScriptMode.description: Whether run scripts may run in several workspaces at once. An unrecognised value falls back to `concurrent`.

filesToCopy.description: Gitignore-style patterns for untracked files copied into every new workspace. A repository's .worktreeinclude outranks this.

previewUrls.description: Preview URLs offered for a workspace.

previewUrlTemplate.description: Template a workspace's preview URL is built from.

enterpriseDataPrivacy.description: Accepted and type-checked; nothing reads it today.

environmentVariables.description: Repository-scoped environment variables passed to agent sessions, scripts, and terminals.

spotlightTesting.description: Accepted and type-checked; nothing reads it today.

ampExecutablePath.description: Accepted and type-checked; nothing reads it today. Pin a runtime's executable in Settings → Providers instead.

claudeExecutablePath.description: Accepted and type-checked; nothing reads it today. Pin a runtime's executable in Settings → Providers instead.

codexExecutablePath.description: Accepted and type-checked; nothing reads it today. Pin a runtime's executable in Settings → Providers instead.

copilotExecutablePath.description: Accepted and type-checked; nothing reads it today. Pin a runtime's executable in Settings → Providers instead.

geminiExecutablePath.description: Accepted and type-checked; nothing reads it today. Pin a runtime's executable in Settings → Providers instead.

opencodeExecutablePath.description: Accepted and type-checked; nothing reads it today. Pin a runtime's executable in Settings → Providers instead.

piExecutablePath.description: Accepted and type-checked; nothing reads it today. Pin a runtime's executable in Settings → Providers instead.

actionPreferences.description: Custom instructions attached to the workspace action buttons. The repository's committed `[prompts]` block outranks these.

general.description: Master prompt prepended to the first message of every new chat in the repository.

scripts.description: Repository scripts. A repository's committed `[scripts]` block outranks these.

setup.description: Command run when a new workspace is created.

archive.description: Command run before a workspace is archived.

run.description: Legacy single run command, upgraded into one implicit run script named `run`. Ignored when `runScripts` is non-empty.

runScripts.description: Named run scripts, in declaration order.

runScript.description: One named run script, in the camelCase spelling the resolver reads. A repository's own [scripts.run.<name>] tables use the TOML spelling instead.

name.description: Script name. Duplicates are dropped first-wins.

command.description: Shell command to run. An entry without one is dropped.

isDefault.description: Marks the script ⌘R and the Run button start. At most one script keeps it — a second is rejected and loaded as false.

availableIn.description: Environments the script is offered in. Ensemblr is local-only, so a script that declares this without `local` is filtered out of the Run menu. Omitted means available.

runScriptIcon.description: One of the curated run-script icon names. The list is closed so a committed config can never name an icon that fails to render; anything outside it falls back to `play`.
